About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) Are you passionate
about turning complex production data into robust manufacturing
stability? As an SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you
will be at the heart of our quality defense team in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will take ownership of the quality, calibration,
and tool matching of inline metrology systems (such as OCD, CDSEM, and
Overlay). Simultaneously, you will drive our Statistical Process
Control (SPC) system enhancements to predict manufacturing risks,
analyze data trends, and prevent process deviations. This role is a
unique opportunity to combine physical engineering with advanced
statistical analysis in a brand-new, state-of-the-art semiconductor
fab. Tasks Metrology Quality Assurance: Oversee the performance and
accuracy of critical inline metrology tools (including CDSEM, OCD, and
Overlay) to ensure stable process measurement. Tool Performance
Matching: Develop, implement, and monitor calibration and cross-fab
matching methods to guarantee uniform measurements across all
metrology tools. SPC System Enhancement: Drive the continuous
improvement of SPC systems, including control limit setup, CPK
monitoring, process audits, and data analysis. Statistical Analysis &
Risk Prevention: Apply advanced statistical methods (such as Design of
Experiments (DOE), sampling plans, and reliability modeling) to
predict risks and resolve quality issues. Data-Driven Development:
Program and develop custom statistical algorithms and analysis scripts
to automate quality monitoring and defense reporting. HQ
Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams at our Taiwan
headquarters to align local metrology and SPC standards with global
best practices. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or
Master’s degree in Material Engineering, Statistics, Industrial
Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field.
Professional Background: 0 to 3 years of experience in high-tech
manufacturing, ideally within the semiconductor industry. Statistical
Foundation: Strong knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC)
procedures, CPK analysis, and statistical evaluation techniques.
Programming Skills: Proficiency in statistical software/programming
languages such as JMP or R. Languages: Fluent in English (written and
spoken) for everyday communication in our international company.
Onboarding: Readiness to participate in an extended, hands-on training
assignment in Taiwan. Nice-to-Have: Hands-on experience with metrology
tools (CDSEM, OCD, or Overlay inspection systems). Programming skills
in Python. A certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt. Basic
conversational skills in German and/or Mandarin. We offer Help build a
completely new semiconductor manufacturing site in Europe. Work in a
highly international environment with colleagues across Europe, Taiwan
and the US. Shape processes instead of maintaining existing
structures. Participate in global projects and cross-functional
collaboration. International onboarding including 9-12 months of
training in Taiwan. Additional contact details Please apply with your
english resume.

Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranksfirst among universityhospitalsin North Rhine-Westphalia andsecond nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. The arbovirus research group of PD Dr. Beate Kümmerer at the Institute of Virology at the University Hospital Bonn (Germany) is looking for a highly motivated

PhD student (m/f/d)

to join our team and explore the fascinating biology of orthoflavivirus-host interaction in mosquitoes and vertebrates. The PhD position (65% E13 salary according to DFG recommendations), initially limited to three years, is advertisedwithin the framework of the DFG-funded CRC/Transregio 237 “Nucleic Acid Immunity” and is to be filled by January 2027.

The position is offered on a fixed-term basis until December 31, 2029.
Mosquito-borne RNA viruses, such as dengue, yellow fever, and Zika virus, cause severe disease outbreaks worldwide. As climate change drives the spread of mosquito vectors, the regions affected by these viruses continue to expand. Orthoflaviviruses have evolved multiple strategies to evade innate immune recognition, thereby promoting viral replication and pathogenesis. The project aims to elucidate how viral RNA structures and RNA modifications shape innate immune recognition. A particular focus will be the identification of mosquito proteins that recognize viral cap0 RNA and the characterization of viral immune antagonists in both mosquito and vertebrate hosts. We hope to gain mechanistic insights into virus-host interactions that support the development of innovative antiviral therapies and sustainable vector control strategies.

Methods: Molecular biology methods, cell culture and virological methods, RNA-protein and protein-protein interaction studies, gene expression analyses, cellular knock-down, as well as research involving mosquitoes.

Master’s degree in life sciences
Enthusiasm for research in a collaborative environment
Commitment to the research project
Profound knowledge in basic molecular biological methods and cell culture
Experience in virology and/or protein-RNA/protein interaction studies would be ideal
Eligibility, willingness and physical fitness to work in a biosafety lev el (BSL) 3 laboratory
Interest in working with live mosquitoes
Motivation to learn new methods
Fluent oral and written English

A 3-year PhD position (65% TV-L E13) with strong mentoring and integration into a high-profile research network (CRC/Transregio 237)
An interdisciplinary research environment at one of Germany’s top universities
A highly collaborative research team

Access to further education in university and non-university courses
Integration into the Bonn International Graduate School (BIGS) Immunosciences and Infection

Responsible and diverse: A position with plenty of room for creativity and responsibility within a supportive and collegial team

Fair compensation: Pay according to the TV-L collective agreement, including annual bonus and company pension scheme

Family-friendly flexibility: Flexible working time models, access to a place in our company daycare center, and programs supporting employees returning from parental leave

Smart commuting: Excellent connection to the SWB public transport network

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

A Snapshot of Your Day
Join our global and diverse Gas Services (GS) organization, where putting the customer at the heart of every decision and continuously improving how we operate are the foundation of quality. Quality is more than reporting, firefighting, and correcting issues after the fact — it is about turning experience into sustainable learning and lasting improvement.
As Service Quality Professional you will act as a trusted partner and point of contact for our Regional Service Unit (RSU), driving important Service Quality initiatives and process improvements across GS. You will connect the Regional Service Units, Global Service Operations, and other stakeholders on key quality topics — sharing best practices, driving common standards, and creating transparency. Balancing global, strategic initiatives with selective, hands-on regional support, you will help ensure quality programs are successfully implemented and that sustainable improvements — measured by non-conformance costs (NCC) and customer satisfaction (NPS) — are achieved.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Act as a reliable, competent point of contact for RSU on quality topics, hurdles, and questions, ensuring RSU interests are considered in EQS decision-making.
* Enable the RSU QM community by providing the support needed to successfully implement quality programs and achieve measurable, sustainable improvements in Service Quality.
* Drive global focus-area initiatives — Customer Excellence / NPS, Service CAPA, and Process Management — in alignment with RSU needs, EQS stakeholders, and process owners.
* Support and govern prioritized improvement projects across regions, and global functions, ensuring visible, customer-felt impact.
* Foster process implementation, harmonization, and comparability of results across RSUs to reduce complexity and boost efficiency.
* Act proactively based on data — leverage dashboards, KPIs, and AI-supported insights to identify focus areas and accelerate decisions.
* Identify global, systemic issues and initiate targeted, cross-regional improvement actions, applying structured problem-solving and continuous-improvement methods.
* Facilitate best-practice sharing by highlighting regional successes and systematically addressing areas for improvement across the GS Service network.
* Provide transparency through structured reporting, and maintenance of relevant frameworks (e.g., Hoshin Kanri, Quality DoR)

What You Bring

* University degree in engineering, business, quality management, or a comparable field.
* Solid experience in quality management, process management, service operations, or continuous improvement, ideally within a complex, international, service-oriented organization.
* Understanding of quality methods and standards (e.g., ISO 9001), including non-conformance management, and their integration into daily processes.
* Experience applying continuous improvement and problem-solving methodologies (e.g., Lean Six Sigma, root-cause analysis) across multiple organizations.
* Affinity for digitalization and AI to make quality and process knowledge more accessible and processes smarter (e.g., SEPH, BIC Cloud, and related tools).
* Excellent stakeholder management, great communicator, and organizational skills, with the ability to build trust across cultures, regions, and hierarchy levels.
* Proactive, self-driven, and customer-centric mindset, balancing global strategic goals with pragmatic regional support.
* Fluency in English; further languages are a plus given the global scope of the role.

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs 

#PRO

You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.  

**CGM Leverages AI:** We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better. 

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference – **for a world where knowledge saves lives!** 

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions—while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region, the university can unfold to its full potential and showcase its innovative power and dynamism. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching and has great potential for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its institutes are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center - creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from every continent.
PhD student: Plant RNA Biology
The Wachter group at the Institute for Molecular Physiology (Faculty 10: Biology of Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz) investigates the molecular mechanisms and biological functions of alternative RNA splicing in plants. Our recent work identified a structured mRNA element that regulates specific DEAD-box helicase genes and revealed their critical role in controlling alternative splicing. Intriguingly, these functions appear to be linked to unique C-terminal features of the respective helicases. As a member of an interdisciplinary and international research team, you will investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying the splicing-regulatory activity of these DEAD-box helicases, with a particular focus on the functional relevance of RGG motifs, subcellular localisation, and their potential involvement in phase separation. In collaboration with the Weinberg group (University Halle-Wittenberg), you will also explore how helicase targeting of pre-mRNA structural elements may intersect with the binding of splicing regulators to determine splice site choice. Your research will employ a multidisciplinary approach that integrates molecular biology, RNA biochemistry, cell biology, and plant physiology, with Arabidopsis thaliana as the primary model system. You will benefit from extensive expertise, various core facilities, and a completely new research infrastructure. The PhD project is funded by the DFG and can be integrated in the international PhD programme (IPP) in Mainz.
Applying state-of-the-art techniques for gene-specific and genome-wide analyses of RNA biology, including transcriptome-wide profiling of alternative splicing and mapping of protein-RNA interactions
Employing in vitro and in vivo experimental systems to address different levels of complexity and advance our understanding of the biological functions
Contributing to teaching activities for Bachelor’s and Master’s students within our group
Assisting with organizational and administrative tasks
Presenting your research findings in oral and written form, including conference contributions, reports, and manuscripts

A successfully completed scientific university degree in Biology or in a related field
Practical experience with a spectrum of molecular methods
A background in plant molecular biology and/or RNA biology
Very good English language skills (at least level B2)
A fascination for science, very good communication, and teamwork skills

Flexible working hours, 30 days' vacation and fair rules for balancing work and family life
Together, we are advancing science and society on this lively and dynamic campus

Opportunity to participate in general university sports programs

The Research Engineer will contribute to driving R&D initiatives within a dynamic industrial setting, focusing on the development of new products, services, and basic knowledge of steel casting fluxes (mold powder for continuous casting of steel) and raw materials. The role encompasses applications in continuous casting of steel. This position bridges laboratory research and plant operations, emphasizing sustainable solutions, process efficiencies, and delivering high-quality results for industrial clients worldwide.

Responsibilities:

1. Project Management :

- Define research programs aligned with new product and service objectives.
- Organize and execute laboratory-scale R&D projects.
- Performs tasks/projects and takes the responsibility for assuring quality, cost effectiveness & timeliness for those projects
- Develop materials and processes while supporting related projects.
- Maintain regular reporting on project progress and outcomes.
- Supervise customer sample preparation and optimize products based on feedback.
- Monitor technical advancements in the market, including patents and scientific publications.
- Consolidate fundamental knowledge on steel casting fluxes and associated raw materials.

2. Laboratory Research and Data Management :

- Plan research activities, including experiments, characterization, and analytics
- Manage, process, analyse, and document data from lab activities.
- Maximize data collection value from R&D, production, and quality assurance.
- Develop project reviews, technical reports, and presentations with clarity and precision.
- Document knowledge and findings in technical memos and share them with stakeholders.
- Utilize project management tools (e.g., Vantage) for deliverables and resource planning.
- Organize stage-gate meetings and prioritize multiple projects.

3. External Collaboration and Scientific Contributions :

- Prepare papers, proposals, and presentations for conferences, congresses, and seminars.
- Build external collaborations and networks to share and extend expertise.
- Address intellectual property topics, support evaluations, and assist in patent filings.

Requirements: 

- PhD or master’s degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mineralogy, or a related engineering discipline, preferably with a focus on casting fluxes (mold powders), glass chemistry, and/or interactions between slag and liquid steel.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in R&D, project management, or product development, ideally within or for a steel plant environment.
- Comprehensive knowledge of continuous steel casting processes, mineralogy, and ceramic raw materials for casting fluxes, including their melting and solidification mechanisms under high-temperature conditions.
- Strong expertise in thermodynamics and reaction kinetics, with proficiency in thermodynamic calculation tools (e.g., FactSage®).
- Hands-on experience with advanced analytical techniques, such as high-temperature viscometry, hot-stage microscopy, TG/DTA, XRD, and Rietveld refinement.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation.
- Strong technical writing and presentation skills, including the ability to clearly summarize research outcomes and present results during stage-gate or project review meetings.
- Motivated, adaptable, and innovative, with a proactive approach to challenges and a strong drive for continuous improvement.
- Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively in an international environment and partner across R&D and plant operations.
- Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken.
